{{Virgo}}
Virgo 3 is the 255th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 3rd day of Virgo, and it is a Wednesday. It corresponds to ISO week 37, weekday 3.

Its informal Japanese name is 10宮3日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 255|Chapter 255]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152274}}.
